seo.description: Official interactive docs for Kawaijs: an open-source, web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py. Write .kawa scripts, run in the browser, and ship a static site.
seo.aiSummary: Kawaijs is an open-source, web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py. Write indentation-based .kawa scripts, preview with kawa dev, try the browser playground, and build a static dist/ for GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, or itch.io. Includes save/load, backlog, rollback, PWA, i18n, and built-in SEO (Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt). Created by Biagio Scaglia. MIT licensed.

acceptedAnswer.text: Kawaijs is a web-native visual novel engine inspired by Ren'Py. It lets you write .kawa scripts and ship a static site that runs in any modern browser.
Kawaijs was created by Biagio Scaglia. It is open source under the MIT license on GitHub.

mainEntity.name: How do I start a Kawaijs project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Run npx kawa create my-novel, then npx kawa dev to preview with live reload, and npx kawa build to export a dist/ folder.

mainEntity.name: Can I deploy a Kawaijs novel to GitHub Pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. kawa build produces a static dist/ with index.html, assets, PWA files, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt - ready for GitHub Pages or any static host.
Yes. kawa.config.json configures author, description, keywords, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD (including FAQPage), favicon, sitemap, and llms.txt for search and answer engines.
Yes. Kawaijs is free and open source under the MIT license.
